name: VW group MQB templates
author: bod3
description: Examples for MQB vehicles (e.g. Tiguan AD1). Module addresses are the usual MQB CAN IDs; the output identifiers are placeholders that must be confirmed against the module's ODX/label data before use.

recipes.name: Horn (template)
recipes.description: Sounds the horn for up to 2 seconds through the central electronics (BCM).
safety: Unverified template: confirm the identifier for your BCM part number first.
The horn is loud: warn people nearby and do not run this in closed spaces.

recipes.name: Rear window wiper (template)
recipes.description: Runs the rear wiper motor for up to 5 seconds.
safety: Unverified template: confirm the identifier for your BCM part number first.
Wet the rear window first and keep hands clear of the wiper arm.

recipes.name: Instrument cluster gauge test (template)
recipes.description: Runs the cluster self-test routine (needles, warning lamps) and polls its result.
safety: Unverified template: confirm the routine identifier for your cluster first.
Warning lamps light up during the test; this is expected.
